focuses.name: Deal with the New Kingdom
focuses.desc:
Greater Romania - doubled in size in 1918, ringed by neighbours who want their land back: the Soviet Union wants Bessarabia, Hungary wants Transylvania, Bulgaria wants Southern Dobruja. King Carol II rules through a camarilla; the Iron Guard murders its way towards power; Ploiesti's oil makes Romania worth having for anyone who wins.

THE TREE (WiF draft), 1936-1952, starting - as vanilla does - with 'Deal with the New Kingdom'.

FOUR STRUCTURES:
1. THE MILITARY - its own tree (army, armour, air force, navy).
2. INDUSTRY - its own tree (Ploiesti, Resita, Malaxa, the railways, the grain), with the extra research slot (The Polytechnic of Bucharest).
3. POLITICS - fluid: King Carol's camarilla, the 1937 election, the Iron Guard question, the summer of 1940, then a government: KING MICHAEL (monarchist), MANIU'S NATIONAL PEASANTS (democratic) or THE CONDUCATOR (authoritarian, Antonescu - fascist-leaning, with the National Legionary State and its end). No separate fascist tree.
4. ALIGNMENT - also fluid: whichever government rules, Romania can join the AXIS (Tripartite Pact) or stand with the ALLIES. The Axis road leans authoritarian and fascist ('Order and Discipline' pushes the government that way); it runs through Barbarossa, Odessa, Sevastopol and Transnistria to an Axis-world 1950 (Romania on the Bug against Reichskommissariat Ukraine, the Grossraum, the Reich divided, Rome and Ankara courting, King Michael's choice). The Allied road runs from the British guarantee and the plan to wreck Ploiesti to a last free kingdom in the Balkans.

IF ROMANIA CAPITULATES (to build): it leaves the war entirely. If Hungary already holds Northern Transylvania it gets ALL of Transylvania, and the rest of Romania becomes a German puppet. On the Allied road the tree then splits: 'The Rump Kingdom' (available as a German subject) leads onto the Axis endgame; 'Victory over Germany' (available once Germany capitulates) leads to a kingdom among the victors; 'The Free Balkans' is for a Romania still standing in a German-won world. The Axis road needs no split: a losing Axis Romania has 'The Turn of the Tide' and the Soviet flip.

TRANSYLVANIA: settled by Germany's Second Vienna Award in 1940 (a German decision; Romania only gets the event) - Northern Transylvania is Hungarian, and Germany guarantees the line. Only while the Reich is in civil war can Romania (on either road) start a LIMITED WAR with Hungary over it. 'The Turn of the Tide' crosses from the Axis road to the Allied one if Germany is losing.

THE SOVIET FLIP (to build): if the Soviet Union is at war with Romania and brings it to 25% surrender WITHIN TWO YEARS of the war starting, Romania turns communist: it leaves its war and its faction, becomes a COLONY (autonomy_colony) of the USSR, and loads the 7-year Communist Romania tree (map rom-com). The Soviet Union chooses who rules:
- A SOVIET OFFICIAL - the base game's Romanian communist leader, Constantin Ion Parhon.
- A LOCAL COLLABORATOR - Petru Groza of the Ploughmen's Front (the user's portrait), with hardline traits: Marxist Fundamentalist and Political Commissar.

focuses.name: In the Grossraum
focuses.desc:
Romania is the oil and grain department of the German economic space: fixed prices, German managers, guaranteed markets.

Effect: +2 civilian factories. -10% consumer goods. Germany +15 opinion.

focuses.name: Constanta on the Black Sea
focuses.desc:
With the Soviet fleet gone, Constanta is the second port of the Black Sea.

Effect: +2 dockyards. +1 naval base.

focuses.name: Odessa, a Romanian City
focuses.desc:
Romanian universities, Romanian street names, a Romanian governor in the Vorontsov Palace.

Effect: +1 civilian factory in Odessa. +10% compliance there.

focuses.name: The Reich Divided
focuses.desc:
The Reich is at war with itself. Its guarantee of the Vienna line is worth nothing. Romania's oil is suddenly Romania's again.

Available: the German civil war has begun.
Effect: +10% political power. +5 oil.

focuses.name: The Invitation from Rome
focuses.desc:
Italy's Pact of Rome asks Romania in: Latin sisters together.

Available: Italy's Pact of Rome exists.
Effect: join Italy's faction. Italy +50 opinion.

focuses.name: Ankara's Offer
focuses.desc:
Turkey offers trade and a frontier guarantee - and wants Ploiesti's oil.

Effect: Turkey +50 opinion. +1 civilian factory (trade).

focuses.name: King Michael's Choice
focuses.desc:
In 1944 he took Romania out of the Axis. Now, with the Reich in pieces, he can take it out of Berlin's orbit for good.

Effect: leave Germany's faction. +15% stability. The reunified Reich -50 opinion.

focuses.name: Romania in 1952
focuses.desc:
Greater Romania survived the war that destroyed Europe - by choosing sides well, and changing them in time.

Effect: +15% stability. +10% factory output.

focuses.name: Take Back Transylvania
focuses.desc:
The Vienna line was guaranteed by Berlin and Rome. Berlin is fighting itself, and Rome is busy. For a few months, Northern Transylvania is only Hungary's to defend.

Available: the German civil war has begun.
Available: Hungary owns Northern Transylvania.
Effect (to build): a LIMITED WAR against Hungary - Hungary may call no one, and we may call no one - on a 60-day timer:
- If Hungary capitulates or we hold Cluj when the timer runs out: Northern Transylvania is ours again, and cored; white peace.
- If not: white peace, the line stays, and we get 'The Humiliation of Cluj' (-15% stability, -15% war support for a year).

focuses.name: Cluj Regained
focuses.desc:
The Romanian flag over the Cluj city hall again, four years late or twelve years late.

Available: we own Northern Transylvania.
Effect: +15% stability. +1 civilian factory in Cluj. +10% compliance in Northern Transylvania.

focuses.name: Deny Ploiesti
focuses.desc:
The British plan, prepared in 1939-40: wreck the oil fields rather than let Germany have them.

Effect: Germany -50 opinion. Allies +25 opinion. If Germany attacks: oil fields destroyed for a year.

focuses.name: The Polish Gold
focuses.desc:
September 1939: Poland's gold reserve crosses Romania to Constanta and the West - and Romania lets it pass.

Effect: Allies +20 opinion. Poland +50 opinion.

focuses.name: The Balkan Front
focuses.desc:
With Yugoslavia and Greece, a front against Germany in the Balkans.

Effect: Yugoslavia and Greece +25 opinion. +2 land forts on the Hungarian border.

focuses.name: The Polish Soldiers
focuses.desc:
Tens of thousands of interned Polish soldiers are let 'escape' to France to fight again.

Effect: Allies +15 opinion. Germany -15 opinion.

focuses.name: Hold the Carpathians
focuses.desc:
The mountains are Romania's fortress against the Wehrmacht.

Effect: +3 land forts in the Carpathian passes. +10% defence.

focuses.name: British Aid via the Straits
focuses.desc:
Supplies through Turkey and the Black Sea.

Effect: +3000 infantry equipment, +50 fighters.

focuses.name: War with Germany
focuses.desc:
The Wehrmacht will come for the oil. Romania will make it pay.

Effect: +15% war support. +10% defence on core territory.

focuses.name: The Free Romanian Committee
focuses.desc:
Romanians in London and Washington, ready to govern in exile.

Effect: government in exile allowed. +10% political power.

focuses.name: Romania Among the Allies
focuses.desc:
Romania fights for the side it chose - or came back to.

Effect: +15% stability. Allies +25 opinion.

focuses.name: The Free Balkans
focuses.desc:
Germany has won in the West or the East - but has not come for Romania, or has not managed to break it. A free Romania is an island in an Axis sea.

Available: Germany has beaten the Western Allies or the Soviet Union.
Also: Romania is not a German subject.
Effect: +10% war support. +3 land forts on every border.

focuses.name: The Organisation of Free Nations
focuses.desc:
Across the Atlantic, America has founded an alliance for what is left of the free world.

Available: the Organisation of Free Nations exists.
Effect: join it.

focuses.name: The Rump Kingdom
focuses.desc:
Romania capitulated. The war is over for it: Hungary takes all of Transylvania, and what is left becomes a German protectorate in all but name.

Available: Romania is a German subject.
Effect: +10% stability (the war is over). -10% war support.

focuses.name: The Refugees from Transylvania
focuses.desc:
Hundreds of thousands of Romanians flee south over the Carpathians from Hungarian rule.

Effect: +20000 manpower. -5% stability. Claims on all of Transylvania (for later).

focuses.name: A Government Berlin Trusts
focuses.desc:
The occupiers want men they can work with: generals, legionaries, the right kind of King's men.

Effect: fascism +15%. Democratic -15%. Germany +25 opinion.

focuses.name: A Place in the New Order
focuses.desc:
Defeat makes Romania an Axis state. Its oil now flows north - and its future runs on the German road.

Available: Romania is a German subject.
Effect: Germany +25 opinion. Unlocks the Axis endgame (the Grossraum, Constanta, the Reich Divided - and with it the war for Transylvania).

focuses.name: Victory over Germany
focuses.desc:
The Reich has capitulated. Romania is on the winning side - this time from the start, or almost.

Available: Germany has capitulated.
Effect: +15% stability, +10% war support.

focuses.name: Northern Transylvania Returned
focuses.desc:
The victors annul the Vienna Award.

Effect: Northern Transylvania becomes Romanian and cored, if Hungary was on the losing side.

focuses.name: At the Peace Conference
focuses.desc:
Romania sits with the victors in Paris, not with the defeated.

Effect: Allies +25 opinion. +2 civilian factories (reconstruction credits).

focuses.name: A Kingdom Among the Victors
focuses.desc:
Greater Romania restored, on the right side of history.

Effect: +15% stability. +10% research speed.

focuses.name: The Last Free Kingdom
focuses.desc:
In 1952 Romania is still free - against every expectation.

Effect: +15% stability, +10% research speed.
